accepted: One new 60s fixed-work switch-interval probe, no target source edits, no profiler, no training.
Actual r11 Guard/integrity.verify and unchanged contender; fixed A1/B1/A2/B2 order at .005/.0001 seconds.
Any failure stops; <1s and >=10x short-interval criteria and >=4s baseline criterion fixed before invocation.

qualifications: The approximately2400 profiler calls are not measured GIL-release or handoff counts. Cached metadata calls and short hash updates need not release the GIL. The 8-16s quantitative fit remains an approximation.
Unprofiled stress establishes slowdown without cProfile, but does not quantify cProfile overhead in the separate profile.
The claimed14percent batching upper bound and predicted11-14s are unsupported analytical estimates, not measured limits.

A shorter process-global switch interval changes contender and sampler scheduling together. A positive probe supports this intervention under the fixed workload; it does not uniquely identify every wait or predict production MPS speedup.
Single Guard verify_lock is not a process-wide lock against all interval setters. Any future helper needs explicit single-writer/main-thread assumptions or synchronization and failure-path review.
Two nested finally blocks cover tested single interruptions, not arbitrary repeated asynchronous exceptions. A leaked interval can affect time/resource guard outcomes, not only performance.
Fork can inherit interpreter state; exec launches a fresh interpreter. Do not claim all child processes cannot inherit the interval.
classification.json contains changed source digests and must be freshly derived along with manifests/identity/registration in any new candidate. Byte-identical classification is not accepted.
If either default pass is below4s while short passes meet their criteria, parent classifies the outcome inconclusive, including the mixed case omitted from the child plan.
The child receipt discloses /tmp/sonnet_r1_start.txt, violating output-only scope. It is an epoch marker, not a runtime defect. The claim that nothing outside its output was touched is not accepted.
The receipt records ledger hashes/size but no exact ledger snapshot artifact. Treat it as contextual observation, not preserved snapshot bytes.
